title: Greenhouse Jobs Scraper input
description: Search jobs across our tracked Greenhouse company boards, or use Specific companies for explicit boards.

mode.title: Search mode
mode.description: Default searches the maintained directory. Specific companies preserves the legacy boards input and permits additional boards.

companyTokens.title: Tracked companies
companyTokens.description: Optional board tokens from the maintained directory. The Console supports a string list; enter tokens such as stripe or airbnb.

additionalBoards.title: Additional board URLs or tokens
additionalBoards.description: Optional public Greenhouse board tokens or standard board URLs for Specific companies mode.

boards.title: Legacy Greenhouse boards
boards.description: Backward-compatible board tokens or https://boards.greenhouse.io/{token} / https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/{token} URLs. Supplying boards without mode selects Specific companies mode.

titleKeywords.title: Job-title keywords
titleKeywords.description: Case-insensitive literal OR matching within employer-provided job titles.

locationKeywords.title: Location keywords
locationKeywords.description: Case-insensitive literal OR matching within employer-provided location text; no radius or geocoding.

departmentKeywords.title: Department keywords
departmentKeywords.description: Case-insensitive literal OR matching within department names.
